asks: Could you move that one thing?
Is anybody coming to take over?
description: The counter is a set of shoulders, bare and broad and running the whole length of the room, holding steady at exactly the height a counter is. Everything on it's resting on somebody.
emotes: {it} takes a slow breath and everything on it rises and settles.
{it} tenses when you put something down, and then eases off.
looks: It's warm, and if you leave a hand on it long enough you can feel it breathing.
The weight of what's stacked on it has left pale marks that haven't gone away.
It's holding very still, deliberately, so that nothing slides.
name: a long pair of shoulders
says: You can lean. Most people lean.
It isn't heavy so much as it never stops.
Don't put the hot one down on the left.
